description: This file defines the Banner model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to manage banner records in the database such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving banners and their associated images.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Model class for managing banners within the Opencart admin design module, including CRUD operations and image management.

methods.name: addBanner
methods.description: Creates a new banner record in the database with provided data, including optionally adding associated images.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified banner identified by its ID.

methods.name: editBanner
methods.description: Updates an existing banner's details and associated images.

methods.name: deleteBanner
methods.description: Deletes a banner record and its associated images from the database.

methods.name: getBanner
methods.description: Retrieves a banner record by its ID.

methods.name: getBanners
methods.description: Retrieves a list of banners based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalBanners
methods.description: Returns the total count of banners in the database.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds a banner image record associated with a specific banner and language.

methods.name: deleteImages
methods.description: Deletes all images associated with a specific banner.

methods.name: deleteImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all images associated with a specified language ID.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves images for a specific banner and language, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a specific language ID.
